RC-DEPENDENCY-001.description: Committed dependency graph cannot be installed or resolved.

RC-DEPENDENCY-ZERO-DEBT-001.description: Direct dependency declarations are not aligned with actual source/build/test usage, or the committed lockfile drifts from the declared dependency graph.

RC-I18N-001.description: Locale or localized UI contract failure.

RC-ROUTER-001.description: Route resolution or registry parity failure.

RC-BUILD-001.description: Production build or generated artifact failure.

RC-RUNTIME-001.description: Browser runtime, page error, or console execution failure.

RC-BROWSER-001.description: Browser gate failed without a more specific root cause.

RC-CI-EVIDENCE-001.description: Evidence is stale, incomplete, or not authoritative for the executed gates.

RC-CI-CONTRACT-001.description: Workflow and executable certification contract drifted.

RC-CI-DEEP-SEMANTIC-IDENTITY-001.description: DEEP execution evidence used one canonical semanticUnitId while certification ownership lookup reconstructed a different key shape, producing false missing-unit failures despite complete 20-locale x 3-browser evidence.

RC-G4-FIREFOX-NATIVE-DOWNLOAD-001.description: Firefox did not emit Playwright's download event for the result-control synthetic anchor click, even though the generated image Blob and result object URL were valid. The cross-browser contract is repaired by exposing the primary Download now control as a native download link while preserving the existing user-facing role and filename contract.

RC-IMAGE-CORE-BOUNDARY-001.description: Image Core document mutators accepted runtime-invalid layer and selection state despite TypeScript types, allowing invalid opacity, transforms, masks, enum values, duplicate identifiers, missing targets, and malformed selection bounds to enter the shared document model.

RC-TOOL-CATALOG-SCALING-001.description: Tool management depended on a flat registry with duplicated lookup patterns, making large tool counts increase routing and discovery overhead and encouraging duplicated per-system catalogs. The scalable replacement is a single indexed Tool Catalog with stable identity, canonical route indexes, alias collision checks, readiness indexing, lazy component loading, and typed operational metadata without unsafe inference.

RC-SEED-REDO-GPU-SYNC-001.description: Seed's browser contract sampled WebGL canvas pixels after UI actions using fixed wall-clock waits, while React state/history changes trigger a requestAnimationFrame render with no observable completion boundary. Under CI scheduling variance, Chromium could sample a previous framebuffer after redo even though the page had no console, page, or network failure. The repair exposes a monotonic data-render-revision only after the GPU render returns successfully and makes pixel assertions await that causal completion signal.

RC-UNKNOWN-001.description: Failure could not be assigned to a known root cause.

RC-SECURITY-BASELINE-IMPORT-001.description: Repository security baseline referenced the REPAIR_GATE_AUTOMATION control-plane registry without importing the symbol, causing a deterministic ReferenceError before the trust-perimeter scan could run.
RC-SECURITY-BASELINE-IMPORT-001.prevention: Security baseline consumers of control-plane registry symbols must import every referenced registry export; exact-head CI execution is the regression proof.

RC-SECURITY-BASELINE-PATH-POLICY-001.description: Repository security baseline compared registry workflow basenames against repository-relative workflow paths and required dynamically generated policy paths to appear as literal strings, causing false security failures after the registry became canonical.
RC-SECURITY-BASELINE-PATH-POLICY-001.prevention: Normalize control-plane registry workflow names to repository-relative paths before allowlist comparison and accept canonical REPAIR_GATE_AUTOMATION expansion rather than requiring duplicated literals.

RC-CI-CONTRACT-LINT-001.description: The canonical CI contract validator contained an unnecessarily escaped quote inside a regex literal, causing ESLint no-useless-escape to fail the WP0 trust baseline.
RC-CI-CONTRACT-LINT-001.prevention: Keep regex literals free of unnecessary string-style quote escaping; lint remains a mandatory contract regression.

RC-CONTROL-PLANE-DRIFT-001.description: Trust-perimeter workflow and path protection rules were duplicated across the registry, repair policy, security baseline, and tests, allowing registry-driven controls to drift from textual assertions.
RC-CONTROL-PLANE-DRIFT-001.prevention: Control-plane workflow ownership, write authority, security-critical workflows, history coverage, and trust perimeter paths must be consumed from the canonical registry.

RC-WATCH-CANCELLATION-001.description: Cancelled workflow runs were treated as generic internal failures without distinguishing valid supersession from an unsuperseded cancellation.
RC-WATCH-CANCELLATION-001.prevention: Classify cancelled runs using same workflow, exact SHA, branch, successor state, and replacement evidence; superseded cancellations are not repair targets.

RC-WATCH-EVIDENCE-001.description: CI log retrieval used a permissive fallback that could leave missing or error text in the evidence map and still allow repair target creation.
RC-WATCH-EVIDENCE-001.prevention: Evidence retrieval emits an explicit capture marker and missing capture forces FAIL_CLOSED before repair dispatch.

RC-WATCH-TARGET-001.description: Repair target selection did not enforce all target invariants before producing targetRunId.
RC-WATCH-TARGET-001.prevention: Require completed failure/timed-out state, exact execution SHA, execution branch, repairable workflow allowlist, no self target, non-superseded state, and evidence before dispatch.

RC-HISTORICAL-LEARNING-001.description: Historical learning defaulted to a partial workflow set and did not persist structured workflow/job/SHA occurrence provenance for each fingerprint.
RC-HISTORICAL-LEARNING-001.prevention: Historical coverage is derived from the canonical registry and fingerprints preserve firstSeenAt, lastSeenAt, occurrences, workflow, jobs, SHA, classification, and strategy metadata.

RC-WATCH-WORKFLOW-SYNTAX-001.description: The evidence-capture shell block was temporarily malformed by incorrect indentation inside a YAML run block, causing the workflow to fail before creating a job.
verification: Daily FLIXO Green Gate exact-SHA run
RC-WATCH-WORKFLOW-SYNTAX-001.prevention: Treat YAML workflow syntax and shell indentation as first-class regression targets before evaluating runtime gate behavior.

RC-ROUTER-PATH-LITERAL-001.description: TanStack Router generated route types reject trailing-slash literal links such as /ar/ when the canonical registered route is /ar; this caused exact-head WP0 typecheck failure.
RC-ROUTER-PATH-LITERAL-001.prevention: Use registered TanStack route literals (/ar) or route templates/params instead of ad-hoc trailing-slash string literals.

RC-CI-CONTRACT-EVIDENCE-REGEX-001.description: The CI contract validator used a cross-line regex that falsely paired a real gh run view --log-failed command with a later intentional || true on gh run list, producing a false RED during canonical static verification.
RC-CI-CONTRACT-EVIDENCE-REGEX-001.prevention: Evidence-swallow checks must be scoped to the same command line or parsed command block; intentional idempotency fallbacks in unrelated commands must not satisfy the forbidden pattern.

RC-AUTO-REPAIR-PROTOCOL-MARKER-001.description: The auto-repair engine migrated reproduction command ownership to evidence.reproductionSelection.commands, but validate-agent-protocol retained the historical impactedTests marker and failed canonical static verification.
RC-AUTO-REPAIR-PROTOCOL-MARKER-001.prevention: Protocol validators must assert current authoritative execution markers after contract migrations and should not depend on obsolete implementation syntax.

RC-WATCH-TEST-EVIDENCE-FIXTURE-001.description: Continuous error watch self-test expected RED_INTERNAL for an internal failed workflow while providing no captured log evidence; the production reducer correctly fails closed on missing evidence.
RC-WATCH-TEST-EVIDENCE-FIXTURE-001.prevention: Internal RED fixtures must include explicit EVIDENCE_CAPTURE=AVAILABLE evidence when asserting RED_INTERNAL; missing evidence is always FAIL_CLOSED.

RC-WATCH-RUN-STORM-001.description: Daily Green Gate workflow_run triggers accumulated duplicate watcher runs because the watcher used one global non-canceling concurrency lane while historical Test System completions continued arriving.
RC-WATCH-RUN-STORM-001.prevention: Watcher executions are supersedable by branch; Auto-Repair execution remains isolated and non-canceling.

RC-AUTO-REPAIR-PUBLISH-STALE-BASE-001.description: The repair publisher previously rebased a verified repair onto a newer execution head when the branch moved during diagnosis, allowing a stale repair to become a new execution commit and churn canonical CI.
RC-AUTO-REPAIR-PUBLISH-STALE-BASE-001.prevention: A repair must publish only when local and remote execution both equal the failed target SHA; any head movement causes fail-closed publication, never rebase.

RC-GREEN-GATE-PENDING-CANCELLATION-001.description: Daily·FLIXO Green Gate observations could be cancelled or superseded before evidence publication because concurrency grouped by branch/SHA and GitHub allows only one pending item per concurrency group.
verification: assert Green Gate concurrency group uses github.run_id

RC-BUILD-TOOLS-CSS-PATH-001.description: src/routes/tools-page.tsx imported tools-modern.css relative to src/routes although the authoritative stylesheet is stored in src/components, causing Vite UNRESOLVED_IMPORT.
RC-BUILD-TOOLS-CSS-PATH-001.prevention: Keep imports aligned with the authoritative module location; the stylesheet is not duplicated.

RC-TASK-AGENT-LEDGER-MARKER-001.description: Task Agent contract validation required an obsolete literal governance marker that was absent from the canonical المهام.md ledger, causing a contract failure even after the ledger filename was corrected.
RC-TASK-AGENT-LEDGER-MARKER-001.prevention: Critical governance invariants must be stated explicitly in the canonical ledger and validated from that single authority.

RC-BROWSER-FIREFOX-NETWORKIDLE-001.description: Firefox DEEP localization/SEO coverage intermittently timed out waiting for Playwright networkidle even though load completed and page assertions/runtime checks otherwise progressed. Chromium and WebKit on the same exact SHA did not reproduce the pattern.
verification: FLIXO Test System Browser DEEP on exact SHA across Firefox/Chromium/WebKit
RC-BROWSER-FIREFOX-NETWORKIDLE-001.prevention: Use deterministic document readiness, font readiness, animation-frame, and idle-callback settling for this local static/runtime contract instead of browser-dependent networkidle quiescence.

RC-AUTOREPAIR-EXPECTED-SHA-001.description: Auto Repair Phase 1 previously failed with EXPECTED_SHA_MISSING even though the target resolver wrote the failed SHA file.
verification: Phase 1 preflight on exact failed SHA with FLIXO_EXPECTED_TARGET_SHA
RC-AUTOREPAIR-EXPECTED-SHA-001.prevention: Propagate the exact target SHA through GITHUB_ENV and retain independent file proof.

RC-AUTOREPAIR-STRATEGY-CASCADE-001.description: Downstream postflight/learning steps could emit a secondary missing strategy artifact error after an upstream strategy/preflight failure.
RC-AUTOREPAIR-STRATEGY-CASCADE-001.prevention: Gate dependent AI phases on upstream success and explicitly fail closed when strategy evidence is absent.
